title: SOM v0.3.2 PROPOSED — delivery.media_available payload
description: Point update of the locked v0.3.1 delivery.media_available. v0.3.2 change (9 Jul, John): the arrival event gains the locator branch for SYMMETRY with asset-side media_refs[] — media in SOM is any media, not just TAMS. Locked v0.3.1 requires a tams:// source only, so a non-TAMS clip/image (MAM path, S3 key, CMS id) can be referenced by an asset but its arrival cannot be announced; this mirrors media_refs[]' anyOf(source|locator) onto the event. DEFERRED (12 Aug 2026): time_range semantics against a non-TAMS locator are well-defined only for TAMS today — pinned at v0.4. Interim: producers SHOULD omit time_range on a bare locator; consumers MUST NOT assume offset-from-zero.

source.description: Fully-qualified TAMS Source URI — tams://store/id; resolves across remote/second-hand stores. Replaces flow_id (Source re-key 29 Jun).

time_range.description: Optional TAMS time range, or list of ranges, onto the Source.

timerange.description: TAMS timerange — bracketed inclusive/exclusive over seconds:nanoseconds timestamps (e.g. [0:500000000_1:0) ). Open-ended start or end permitted.
